paragraphs.title: The Spirit Poured Out on All People

easy.explanation: The KJV says, “I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh.”
easy.q: Upon whom will God pour out His spirit?

easy.explanation: The verse says, “your sons and your daughters shall prophesy.”
The KJV says, “your old men shall dream dreams.”
easy.q: What will the old men dream?

medium.explanation: The verse says, “your young men shall see visions.”
medium.q: What will the young men see?

medium.explanation: God also promises to pour out His spirit upon “the servants and upon the handmaids.”
medium.q: Which additional groups are mentioned in verse 2?

answers: To speak as a messenger of God
medium.explanation: In this passage, prophesying refers to speaking under God's inspiration.
medium.q: What does the word “prophesy” mean in this passage?

answers: God's spirit is limited to one age group
God's spirit is given across ages and social statuses
God's spirit is given only to rulers
challenge.explanation: The passage includes sons, daughters, old men, young men, servants, and handmaids.
challenge.q: What main idea is shown by the groups listed in these verses?

answers: Old men dream dreams, young men see visions, and sons and daughters prophesy
Old men see visions, young men prophesy, and servants dream dreams
Sons and daughters see visions, while young men dream dreams
challenge.explanation: These are the experiences specifically assigned in the KJV passage.
challenge.q: Which pairing correctly matches each group with its experience?

answers: The servants and handmaids are added to those already mentioned
The servants and handmaids are excluded
challenge.explanation: The word “also” adds the servants and handmaids to the people receiving God's spirit.

short_answers.question: Name two groups who will receive God's spirit.
short_answers.answer: Any two of the following: sons, daughters, old men, young men, servants, or handmaids.
short_answers.explanation: The passage names people of different ages and social statuses.

short_answers.question: What will the old men do?
short_answers.explanation: Joel 3:1 says, “your old men shall dream dreams.”

short_answers.question: What will the young men see?
short_answers.explanation: The KJV says, “your young men shall see visions.”

paragraphs.title: Signs and Wonders Before the Day of the Lord

answers: In the heavens and in the earth
easy.explanation: The KJV says, “I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth.”

answers: Blood, fire, and pillars of smoke
easy.explanation: The verse lists “blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.”
easy.q: Which three signs are named together?

answers: It will be turned into darkness
It will fall to the earth
easy.explanation: The KJV says, “The sun shall be turned into darkness.”
easy.q: What will happen to the sun?

medium.explanation: The verse says, “the moon into blood.”

answers: After the Day of the Lord
Before the great and terrible day of the LORD
medium.explanation: The signs occur “before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.”

answers: Columns or rising masses of smoke
medium.explanation: The phrase describes smoke rising in pillar-like columns.

answers: A darkened sun and blood-like moon, together with blood, fire, and smoke
challenge.explanation: The passage mentions signs in the heavens and signs on the earth.
challenge.q: Which answer includes signs from both heaven and earth?

answers: The signs precede the Day of the Lord
The signs follow the Day of the Lord
The signs happen only in Jerusalem
challenge.explanation: The word “before” gives the order of events.
challenge.q: What does “before” establish in these verses?

challenge.explanation: The KJV calls it “the great and the terrible day of the LORD.”
challenge.q: How is the Day of the Lord described?

short_answers.question: Name the three earthly signs listed in the passage.
short_answers.answer: Blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.
short_answers.explanation: These signs are named in Joel 3:3.

short_answers.question: What happens to the sun and the moon?
short_answers.answer: The sun is turned into darkness, and the moon into blood.
short_answers.explanation: This wording comes directly from Joel 3:4.

short_answers.question: When do these signs occur?
short_answers.answer: Before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes.
short_answers.explanation: The signs precede the Day of the Lord.

answers: Whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD
Only those who see the moon
easy.explanation: The KJV says, “whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered.”

answers: In mount Zion and in Jerusalem
easy.explanation: The verse names “mount Zion and Jerusalem” as places of deliverance.
The verse speaks of “the remnant whom the LORD shall call.”

answers: Calling on the LORD is connected with being delivered
Calling on the LORD causes the sun to darken
Calling on the LORD prevents all signs
medium.explanation: The verse directly connects calling on the LORD with deliverance.
medium.q: What is the relationship between calling on the LORD and deliverance?

answers: A dream given to an old man
medium.explanation: Deliverance means rescue, salvation, or escape from danger.
medium.q: What does “deliverance” mean in this passage?

answers: As places where visions are seen only
medium.explanation: The verse says that in mount Zion and Jerusalem there shall be deliverance.
medium.q: How are mount Zion and Jerusalem presented?

answers: Both refer to people associated with deliverance
One refers to the sun and the other to the moon
One refers to fire and the other to smoke
challenge.explanation: Both expressions concern people who receive or belong to God's deliverance.
challenge.q: What common idea connects “whosoever shall call” with “the remnant whom the LORD shall call”?

answers: They are identified as places of deliverance
They are located in the heavens
They are places reserved only for old men
challenge.explanation: The verse specifically names them as places where deliverance shall be found.
challenge.q: Why are mount Zion and Jerusalem specifically mentioned?

challenge.explanation: A remnant is a remaining group or survivors.
challenge.q: What does “the remnant” most nearly mean?

short_answers.question: What must a person do to be delivered?
short_answers.answer: Call on the name of the LORD.
short_answers.explanation: Joel 3:5 gives this promise to whoever calls on the LORD's name.

short_answers.question: Name the two places where there shall be deliverance.
short_answers.explanation: These two places are named in the verse.

short_answers.question: Who are called by the LORD?
short_answers.explanation: The verse refers to “the remnant whom the LORD shall call.”
